post.description:
> 📘 NOTE:
> 
> This page is for the on-prem version of Intelligence which is deprecated. Please complete your migration to the [Intelligence Cloud API](/reference/submitphonenumberforintelligencecloud). This migration is mandatory.

Obtain a risk recommendation for this phone number, as well as other relevant information.

## General requirements
* **Authentication:** [Basic](/enterprise/docs/authentication#basic-authentication) (easiest to implement) or [Digest](/enterprise/docs/authentication#digest-authentication)
* **Encoding:** Accepts only **UTF-8 unicode** characters as inputs.
* **Accepts:** `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`
* **Responds with:** `application/json`
* **Required headers:** `Content-Type - application/x-www-form-urlencoded`
* **Rate limit:** [Default rate limits by product](https://support.telesign.com/s/article/do-you-have-any-rate-limits)

account_lifecycle_event.description:
The attempted action associated with this phone number for which you want to evaluate its risk. Acceptable values for this parameter are -

* create - For the creation of a new account.
* sign-in - For when an end user signs in to their account.
* transact - For when an end user completes a transaction within their account.
* update - For when an update is performed, such as an update of account information or similar.
* delete - For when an account is deleted.

external_id.description: A customer-generated ID for this transaction. The response simply echoes the value provided for this parameter.

originating_ip.description: Your end user's IP address (do not send your own IP address). IPv4 and IPv6 are supported. For IPv4, the value must be in the format defined by the Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF) in the Internet-Draft document titled [Internet Protocol](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc791). For IPv6, the value must be in the format defined by the IETF in the Internet-Draft document titled [IP Version 6 Addressing Architecture](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc4291#section-2.2).

device_id.description: Your end user's device ID. This value is case sensitive.

account_id.description: Your end user's account ID. This value is case sensitive.

email_address.description: Your end user's email address. This value is case sensitive.

get.description:
Use this action to get insights about a phone number such as whether it is active or disconnected, whether its associated device is reachable or unreachable, and its associated device's roaming status. 

To add this product to your account, [contact a Telesign expert](https://www.telesign.com/contact-sales?utm_campaign=contact%20sales%20form&utm_source=developer_portal&utm_medium=Referrer&utm_content=pid_live_status). This product is available for full-service accounts only.

## General requirements
* **Protocols:** `https`
* **Authentication:** [Basic](/enterprise/docs/authentication#basic-authentication) (easiest to implement) or [Digest](/enterprise/docs/authentication#digest-authentication)
* **Encoding:** Accepts only **UTF-8 unicode** characters as inputs.
* **Accepts:** `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`
* **Responds with:** `application/json`
* **Required headers:** `Content-Type - application/x-www-form-urlencoded`
* **Rate limit:** [Default rate limits by product](https://support.telesign.com/s/article/do-you-have-any-rate-limits)

## Frequency of same number requests
Sending too many request to the API for the same phone number within a short period of time may result in an error, even if data is available for that number. If you receive a -60001 error in the response after making consecutive requests for the same phone number, consider limiting your request rate.

parameters.name: ucid
parameters.description:
A string that specifies one of the use case codes. 

| Use Case | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| ATCK | For use in a 2FA situation like updating an account, or trying to log in. |
| BACF | For creating an account on somebody's service in a situation where the service may be vulnerable to bulk attacks or individual fraudsters. |
| BACS | For creating an account on somebody's service in a situation where the service may be vulnerable to bulk attacks or individual spammers. |
| CHBK | For use in a situation such as someone trying to buy something expensive or unusual on your platform, and you want to verify that it is really them. |
| CLDR | Calendar Event | 
| LEAD | For use in a situation where you require a person to enter their personal information in order to obtain information about something like a loan or realty or a school, and you want to check if the person is bogus or not. |
| OTHR | Other - if you have a situation not addressed by the other tags. |
| PWRT | For use in a situation where a password reset is required. |
| RESV | For use in a situation where you have end users making reservations and not showing up, and you want to be able to include some kind of phone verification in that loop. |
| RXPF | For use in situations where you are trying to prevent prescription fraud. |
| SHIP | For use in situations where you are sending a shipping notification. | 
| THEF | For use in situations where you are trying to prevent an end user from deactivating or redirecting a phone number in order to take over someone else's identity. |
| TRVF | For use in situations where you are transferring money, and you want to check to see if it is approved by sending a text message or phone call to your end user. This is similar to CHBK, but is specifically for a money transaction. | 
| UNKN | This is the same as OTHR. |

call_forward_enabled.description:
Whether this phone number has call forwarding enabled.
* `"true"` = It is enabled.
* `"false"` = It is not enabled.

call_forward_type.description: The type of call forwarding enabled for this phone number. Conditional forwarding causes incoming calls to go to another phone line only when the initial destination phone number cannot be reached.

call_forward_condition.description: The conditions under which calls will be forwarded for this number. If the phone number uses unconditional call forwarding or has no call forwarding at all, the value will be `"None"`.

county.description: The county (or parish) associated with the rate center of the phone number when the device was activated (U.S. only).

state.description: The two-letter [state abbreviation code](http://pe.usps.com/text/pub28/28apb.htm) of the state (province, district, or territory) associated with the rate center of the phone number when the device was activated (North America only).

zip.description: The five-digit United States Postal Service [ZIP Code](https://www.usps.com/nationalpremieraccounts/findzipcodes.htm) associated with the rate center of the phone number when the device was activated (U.S. only).

country.description: Contains properties related to the country associated with the rate center of the phone number when the device was activated.

iso2.description: The ISO 3166-1 2-letter [country dialing code](/enterprise/docs/codes-languages-and-time-zones#country-codes-and-dialing-codes) associated with the rate center of the phone number when the device was activated.

iso3.description: The ISO 3166-1 3-letter country code associated with the rate center of the phone number when the device was activated.

name.description: The [country name](/enterprise/docs/codes-languages-and-time-zones#country-codes-and-dialing-codes) associated with the rate center of the phone number when the device was activated.

time_zone.description: Contains properties related to the time zone associated with the rate center of the phone number when the device was activated. For maximum and minimum UTC offsets, they are specified in units of hours, and range from -12 to +14. For positive numbers, the plus sign (+) may not be returned. Additional offsets due to Daylight Savings Time or Summer Time are not considered. For example, Russia, which spans 11 time zones, has a minimum UTC offset of +2, and a maximum of +12.

name.description: The time zone associated with the rate center of the phone number when the device was activated (U.S. only).

utc_offset_max.description: For international phone numbers, this parameter returns the maximum UTC offset for the country associated with the rate center of the phone number when the device was activated. For U.S. phone numbers, this parameter returns the same result as utc_offset_min.

utc_offset_min.description: For international phone numbers, this parameter returns the minimum UTC offset for the country associated with the rate center of the phone number when the device was activated. For U.S. phone numbers, this parameter returns the UTC offset associated with the rate center of the phone number when the device was activated.

coordinates.description: Contains details about the geographical coordinates of the location where the phone number is registered.

latitude.description: Latitude specifies the North-South position of a point on the Earth’s surface. It is an angular measurement that ranges from 0° at the Equator, to 90° at the North Pole (and -90° at the South Pole). It is returned here as a value indicating the number of degrees of latitude of the location associated with the phone number, expressed in seven decimal digits, with five decimal places.

longitude.description: Longitude specifies the East-West position of a point on the Earth’s surface. It is an angle measured East or West from the [prime meridian](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prime_meridian) —ranging from 0° at the prime meridian, to +180° Eastward and -180° Westward. It is returned here as a value indicating the number of degrees of longitude of the location associated with the phone number, expressed in eight decimal digits, with five decimal places.

metro_code.description: A 4-digit string indicating the Primary Metropolitan Statistical Area (PMSA) code for the location associated with the rate center of the phone number when the device was activated (U.S. only). PMSA Codes are governed by the [US Census Bureau](http://www.census.gov/). This information is useful for large metropolitan areas that comprise several smaller cities. For example, the PMSA for Long Beach, California is Los Angeles County, which gives Long Beach the PMSA Code 4480.

carrier.description: Contains information about the company that provides telecommunications services for the phone number.

name.description: The name of the carrier associated with this number.

live.description: Contains details about a subscriber and subscriber's device.

subscriber_status.description:
The current status of the subscriber’s phone number.

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| ACTIVE | The phone number is in service. |
| DISCONNECTED | The phone number is not in service. |

device_status.description:
The current status of the device associated with this number.

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| REACHABLE | The device is on-line, and is ready to initiate/receive calls. Note that subscriber_status=ACTIVE. |
| UNAVAILABLE | The device status is not available for this phone number. |
| UNREACHABLE | The device is either turned off, or it is out of the coverage area. |

roaming.description:
Whether the mobile device is currently roaming outside of the contracted service coverage area.

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| NO | The mobile device is not currently roaming. |
| UNAVAILABLE | The service is unable to make a determination at this time. |
| YES | The mobile device is currently roaming. |

roaming_country.description:
The country in which the mobile device is roaming.

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| A string naming the country | The name of the country (in mixed-case). |
| null | The service is unable to make a determination at this time.

roaming_country_iso2.description: A two-character abbreviation for the country in which the mobile device is roaming.

contact-object.title: contactObject
contact-object.description: Contains contact information for this phone number. You will only see this in your response if you used the associated identity attribute (Contact) and Telesign has enabled it for your account. See *[Phone ID - Identity signals: Contact](doc:phone-id-identity-attributes-contact)* for more details.

address1.description: The name of the street in the address of the subscriber.

address2.description: Unit or suite number in the address of the subscriber.

address3.description: Town, city, or state in the address of the subscriber.

address4.description: Postal code in the address of the subscriber.

city.description: The city in the address of the subscriber.

country.description: The country in the address of the subscriber.

date_of_birth.description: The date of birth of the subscriber, in a RFC 3339 format. This property is not returned by default; to request addition of this property contact our [Customer Support Team](mailto:support@telesign.com).

email_address.description: Email address of the owner of the phone number.

first_name.description: The first name of the subscriber.

id.description: The unique government-issued ID for this subscriber. This property is not returned by default and is only available in limited markets. Contact our [Customer Support Team](mailto:support@telesign.com) to obtain the latest information on supported markets and to add this property to your account.

last_name.description: The last name of the subscriber.

state_province.description: State or province in the address of the subscriber.

zip_postal_code.description: Postal code in the address of the subscriber.

status.description: Contains properties related to the processing status for this identity attribute.

code.description: A numeric code indicating the processing status for this identity attribute.

description.description:
A brief description telling you what the code means.

  2800 - Request successfully completed.

 2801 - Invalid Request addons parameter {parameter_name} 

 2802 - number_deactivation add-on temporarily unavailable

   2803 - Phone number out of number_deactivation add-on coverage. 

  2804 - Phone number not applicable in number_deactivation add-on. 

  2805 - No number_deactivation add-on information for phone_number. 

  2806 - number_deactivation add-on is not enabled. 

  2807 - Some parameters submitted in the request are not valid.

original.description: Contains details about the original phone number included in the request.

complete_phone_number.description: The base phone number prefixed with the [country dialing code](/enterprise/docs/codes-languages-and-time-zones#country-codes-and-dialing-codes).

cleansing.description: Contains details about how the phone number was cleansed. Phone cleansing corrects common formatting issues in submitted phone numbers.

max_length.description: The maximum number of digits allowed for phone numbers with this country dialing code.

min_length.description: The minimum number of digits allowed for phone numbers with this country dialing code.

phone_number.description: The base phone number without the [country dialing code](/enterprise/docs/codes-languages-and-time-zones#country-codes-and-dialing-codes).

min_length.description: The minimum number of digits allowed for phone numbers with this country dialing code.

Risk.title: Risk
Risk.description: Contains properties related to the risk recommendation for the specified phone number.

level.description: The severity of the risk. [Risk Recommendation Scales](/enterprise/docs/intelligence-get-started#risk-recommendation-scales) provides a table.

recommendation.description: The action that Telesign recommends that you take based on the risk recommendation.

score.description: A measure of the transaction risk involved with conducting an online business transaction at the current time for this phone number. The scale ranges from zero to 1000, with a higher value indicating a higher risk.

reference_id.description: A unique identifier assigned by Telesign for this transaction.

external_id.description: A customer-generated ID for this transaction. The response simply echoes the value provided for this parameter.

status.description: Contains properties related to the processing status of this request.

updated_on.description: The date-time when the processing status of this transaction was last updated.

code.description: A numeric code indicating the processing status of this transaction.

description.description: Text explaining the meaning of the status code returned.

errors.description: Each element contains an object describing an error that occurred during processing.

items.description: Contains properties describing one error that occurred during processing.

code.description: A numeric code indicating which error occurred.

description.description: Text explaining the meaning of the error code returned.

RiskInsights.title: RiskInsights
RiskInsights.description:
Contains reason code properties with additional info related to the risk recommendation.
*[Intelligence - Insights reason code mappings](/enterprise/docs/intelligence-insights-reason-code-mappings)* provides the meaning of these reason codes.

status.description:
The processing status of the risk insights package for this request. Possible values are: | Value | Meaning | |-------|---------| | 800 | **Success.**
All fields successfully returned and available for use. | | 801 | **Partial Success.**
No value available for category, but other data is available. | | 803 | **Error.**
An error occurred; no data returned in this response. |

category.description:
Reason codes related to the category of the phone number.
*[Intelligence - Insights reason code mappings](/enterprise/docs/intelligence-insights-reason-code-mappings)* provides the meaning of the codes returned.

a2p.description:
Reason codes specific to application-to-person communication (A2P). These are automated communications sent to a human, like verification codes, appointment reminders, etc.
*[Intelligence - Insights reason code mappings](/enterprise/docs/intelligence-insights-reason-code-mappings)* provides the meaning of the codes returned.

p2p.description:
Reason codes specific to person-to-person communication (P2P). This is two-way communication between two humans, like one friend texting another.
*[Intelligence - Insights reason code mappings](/enterprise/docs/intelligence-insights-reason-code-mappings)* provides the meaning of the codes returned.

number_type.description:
Reason codes related to the phone number’s type.
*[Intelligence - Insights reason code mappings](/enterprise/docs/intelligence-insights-reason-code-mappings)* provides the meaning of the codes returned.

ip.description:
Reason codes related to activity of the IP you provided for this phone number.
*[Intelligence - Insights reason code mappings](/enterprise/docs/intelligence-insights-reason-code-mappings)* provides the meaning of the codes returned.

email.description:
Reason codes related to activity of the email address you provided for this phone number.
*[Intelligence - Insights reason code mappings](/enterprise/docs/intelligence-insights-reason-code-mappings)* provides the meaning of the codes returned.

reqAgeVerify.title: reqAgeVerify
reqAgeVerify.description: Includes the Age Verify identity attribute in processing your request. Pass an empty object to use the minimum legal age of the country as the age threshold. See [Phone ID - Identity signals: Age Verify](/enterprise/docs/phone-id-identity-attributes-age-verify) for more details on how to use this feature.

WARNING: Do not use this feature without first confirming with the [Telesign Customer Support Team](mailto:support@telesign.com) that the countries you intend to use it with are supported! If you use this parameter for a country that is not supported, you may get incorrect results.

Carrier.title: Carrier
Carrier.description: Contains details about the company that provides telecommunications services for this phone number. Behavior of this property, including information returned for ported phone numbers, can vary depending on the country of the phone number. See [How does carrier data vary by country?](https://support.telesign.com/s/article/How-does-carrier-data-vary-by-country) for more details.

carrier_id.description: An ID specifying this carrier. Contact our [Customer Support Team](mailto:support@telesign.com) to include this property in your response.

Location.title: Location
Location.description: Contains geographical location information associated with the rate center of the phone number when the device was activated. Null is returned when data for a field isn't available for a specific market or country.

city.description: The city associated with the rate center of the phone number when the device was activated.

county.description: The county (or parish) associated with the rate center of the phone number when the device was activated (U.S. only).

state.description: The two-letter [state abbreviation code](http://pe.usps.com/text/pub28/28apb.htm) of the state (province, district, or territory) associated with the rate center of the phone number when the device was activated (North America only).

zip.description: The five-digit United States Postal Service [ZIP Code](https://www.usps.com/nationalpremieraccounts/findzipcodes.htm) associated with the rate center of the phone number when the device was activated (U.S. only).

country.description: Contains properties related to the country associated with the rate center of the phone number when the device was activated.

iso2.description: The ISO 3166-1 2-letter [country code](/enterprise/docs/codes-languages-and-time-zones#country-codes-and-dialing-codes) associated with the rate center of the phone number when the device was activated.

iso3.description: The ISO 3166-1 3-letter country code associated with the rate center of the phone number when the device was activated.

name.description: The [country name](/enterprise/docs/codes-languages-and-time-zones#country-codes-and-dialing-codes) associated with the rate center of the phone number when the device was activated.

time_zone.description: Contains properties related to the time zone associated with the rate center of the phone number when the device was activated. For maximum and minimum UTC offsets, they are specified in units of hours, and range from -12 to +14. For positive numbers, the plus sign (+) may not be returned. Additional offsets due to Daylight Savings Time or Summer Time are not considered. For example, Russia, which spans 11 time zones, has a minimum UTC offset of +2, and a maximum of +12.

name.description: The time zone associated with the rate center of the phone number when the device was activated (U.S. only).

utc_offset_max.description: For international phone numbers, this parameter returns the maximum UTC offset for the country associated with the rate center of the phone number when the device was activated. For U.S. phone numbers, this parameter returns the same result as utc_offset_min.

utc_offset_min.description: For international phone numbers, this parameter returns the minimum UTC offset for the country associated with the rate center of the phone number when the device was activated. For U.S. phone numbers, this parameter returns the UTC offset associated with the rate center of the phone number when the device was activated.

coordinates.description: Contains properties with details about the geographical coordinates of the location where the phone number is registered.

latitude.description: Latitude specifies the North-South position of a point on the Earth’s surface. It is an angular measurement that ranges from 0° at the Equator, to 90° at the North Pole (and -90° at the South Pole). It is returned here as a value indicating the number of degrees of latitude of the location associated with the phone number, expressed in seven decimal digits, with five decimal places.

longitude.description: Longitude specifies the East-West position of a point on the Earth’s surface. It is an angle measured East or West from the [prime meridian](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prime_meridian) —ranging from 0° at the prime meridian, to +180° Eastward and -180° Westward. It is returned here as a value indicating the number of degrees of longitude of the location associated with the phone number, expressed in eight decimal digits, with five decimal places.

metro_code.description: A 4-digit string indicating the Primary Metropolitan Statistical Area (PMSA) code for the location associated with the rate center of the phone number when the device was activated (U.S. only). PMSA Codes are governed by the [US Census Bureau](http://www.census.gov/). This information is useful for large metropolitan areas that comprise several smaller cities. For example, the PMSA for Long Beach, California is Los Angeles County, which gives Long Beach the PMSA Code 4480.
